summary: The school district emphasizes the importance of maintaining E-Rate funding to ensure continued internet access and educational services for students, citing the program's cost-effectiveness and necessity in the face of budget constraints.

claims.argument: E-Rate funding is vital for our school district to support internet connection for all school district activities
claims.evidence_quote: E-Rate funding is vital for our school district to support internet connection for all school district activities, network equipment, etc. Our school district does NOT have additional resources to make up this funding if it is ended. We might have to cut student services. Due to increasing inflation, all school districts are having to do more work with less money.
